name: appknox
description: Appknox KnoxIQ fix-and-verify: fetch the vulnerabilities Appknox found in your app, fix them in your repo, verify with the finding's PoC, and re-scan.

access_token.title: Appknox access token
access_token.description: Service-account credential in the form <Access Key ID>:<Secret>. Create one in the Appknox dashboard under Organization settings > Service accounts.

base_url.title: Appknox Public API base URL
base_url.description: Leave as the default unless your organization uses a dedicated or on-prem Appknox instance.
